metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-45.432798, 140.468626) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Ocean color data for chlorophyll-a concentration. Will use "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" which provides chlorophyll_a band - Date: Compare Nov 2019 - Feb 2020 vs Nov 2018 - Feb 2019 - Location: Point at (-45.432798, 140.468626) with 100km radius buffer 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data already has quality flags. Should check for valid pixels and may need to mask based on quality flags or simply filter out null values - No cloud masking needed for ocean data, but need to handle missing data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: Chlorophyll concentration of 0 is technically possible but very rare in ocean (oligotrophic waters might have very low but not zero) - Check pixel counts to ensure we have valid data - Compare mean values between the two periods - If result is None/NaN or pixel count is 0 → C2/C3 - If no images found → C1 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([140.468626, -45.432798]); const roi = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius const period1_start = '2018-11-01'; const period1_end = '2019-02-28'; const period2_start = '2019-11-01'; const period2_end = '2020-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .select('chlor_a'); const col1 = collection .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(roi); const col2 = collection .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(roi); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Nov 2018-Feb 2019) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Nov 2019-Feb 2020) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("One or both periods have no images."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites const img1 = col1.mean(); const img2 = col2.mean(); // 4. Calculation with pixel count validation const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats1 = await img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1['chlor_a_mean']; const count1 = stats1['chlor_a_count']; const mean2 = stats2['chlor_a_mean']; const count2 = stats2['chlor_a_count']; console.log(`Period 1: Mean=${mean1}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean=${mean2}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 == null || mean2 == null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if values are in reasonable range (chlorophyll-a typically 0.01-100 mg/m³) if (mean1 < 0 || mean1 > 200 || mean2 < 0 || mean2 > 200) { console.log("Values out of reasonable range for chlorophyll."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Chlorophyll change: ${((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("Chlorophyll concentrations were UP in 2019-2020 vs 2018-2019."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Chlorophyll concentrations were NOT up in 2019-2020 vs 2018-2019."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
